'''Mer''' (also called '''Muri''', '''Miere''') is a [[Papuan languages|Papuan language]] spoken in [[West Papua Province|West Papua]] province of [[Indonesia]].

==Groups==
There are two groups of Miere speakers:<ref name="Ronsumbre-2020">{{cite book |last=Ronsumbre |first=Adolof |year=2020 |title=Ensiklopedia Suku Bangsa di Provinsi Papua Barat |location=Yogyakarta |publisher=Penerbit Kepel Press |isbn=978-602-356-318-0}}</ref>

*''Gunung'' ("Mountain") or ''Kakak'' ("elder") group, in Yabore village, Naikere District
*''Pantai'' ("Beach") or ''Adik'' ("younger") group, in Senderewoi village, Rasiey District
